saw_lines: Streetwear buyers pick by fit and one hero piece, then come back for the same silhouette in a new colour.
So the sale is won or lost in line one, and your ads open with mood copy, not fit.
Your 30 live ads carry 0 proof numbers, so a first time buyer has nothing to trust. Collect one, your review count or orders shipped, and lead the next batch with it.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 27 Oct 2026
points: None of your 30 live ads shows a proof number, so a first time buyer has nothing to trust before clicking. Collect one figure, your review count or orders shipped, and put it on every creative in the next batch.

Two of your 16 copy ads are creator posts run from the brand page, each pushing one person’s code, which reads as a side deal. Whitelist them from the creator accounts, then cut three variations and run them as brand ads.
Your 16 copy ads mention no offer or discount, so a new buyer has no reason to act today. Give them one, such as a first order offer or a bundle, and put it in line one of three new ads.

Your 16 copy ads open on 11 different stories, and one “bright, light” opener leads 3 of them. Every new story splits the same buyers. Pick two of your current stories and build the next batch from those two only.

ads_1: Two stories from your best lines, pants and loafers, each with a first order offer
soc_1: Brand social strategy across Instagram, TikTok and YouTube
